_about: Hand-maintained. The tools agents act with. os scan turns this into TOOLS.md; os tools install registers every 'claude-code' tool for all projects. Never put API keys here: every hosted tool signs in with OAuth.

apify.use_for: Scraping at scale: thousands of ready-made scrapers (Actors) for Google Maps, social media, e-commerce, search results and directories. Lead lists, competitor prices, reviews, social posts.
apify.not_for: One page or one small site; use firecrawl
apify.auth: OAuth: sign in to your Apify account in the browser on first use. No key is stored.
apify.cost: Runs spend Apify credits. Check an Actor's pricing before a large run.
apify.approval: Ask Tom before a run likely to exceed the free tier.

firecrawl.use_for: Turning websites into clean markdown or structured JSON: scrape a page, map or crawl a site, search the web and read the results, extract fields.
firecrawl.not_for: Platforms that need a logged-in browser; use playwright. Bulk platform scraping; use apify
firecrawl.fallback: the built-in browser for single pages
firecrawl.auth: OAuth: sign in to your Firecrawl account on first use. No key is stored.
firecrawl.cost: Firecrawl credits per page. Crawls can be large; set a page limit.
firecrawl.approval: Ask Tom before crawling more than about 100 pages.
firecrawl.verified: 2026-11-06: docs read; endpoint reachable (405 on plain GET, as expected for MCP).

composio.use_for: Acting in 250+ apps: Gmail, Outlook, Calendar, Sheets, Drive, Notion, Slack, HubSpot, LinkedIn, Instagram and more. Always search its tools first, then check the app has an active connection.
composio.not_for: Apps that have their own connector here (Gmail, Canva); prefer those
composio.fallback: the app's own connector, or ask Tom to paste the data
composio.auth: Already connected on claude.ai. Each app inside it (Gmail, Slack...) needs its own connection; COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS gives Tom a sign-in link.
composio.approval: Reading is fine. Sending, posting, creating or deleting anything in an app needs Tom's explicit OK.
composio.verified: 2026-11-06: connected; Gmail inside Composio not yet connected.

chrome-devtools.use_for: Diagnosing a web page in real Chrome: console errors, network requests, performance traces, screenshots. Use it to find why a site is slow or broken.
chrome-devtools.not_for: Long scripted flows across many pages; use playwright
chrome-devtools.fallback: the built-in browser (console and network reading)
chrome-devtools.auth: None. Uses its own Chrome profile, not Tom's.
chrome-devtools.approval: Do not log in to Tom's accounts or submit forms without his OK.
chrome-devtools.verified: 2026-11-06: Connected per `claude mcp list`, running on portable Node.js 26.13.0 in the user folder.

playwright.use_for: Driving a browser step by step: multi-page flows, form filling, testing a web app end to end, capturing pages that need clicks or scrolling.
playwright.not_for: Reading a public page; use firecrawl. Diagnosing performance; use chrome-devtools
playwright.auth: None. Uses its own browser profile, not Tom's.
playwright.approval: Do not log in, buy, submit or post without Tom's OK.
playwright.verified: 2026-11-06: Connected per `claude mcp list`, running on portable Node.js 26.13.0 in the user folder.

higgsfield.use_for: Generating images and short videos for campaigns, ads, social posts and video scenes.
higgsfield.not_for: Layouts with text, brand templates or carousels; use canva
higgsfield.fallback: canva, or a written brief for a designer
higgsfield.auth: OAuth: sign in to your Higgsfield account on first use. No key is stored.
higgsfield.cost: Generations spend Higgsfield credits; video costs far more than images.
higgsfield.approval: Confirm the brief with Tom before a video generation or any batch.
higgsfield.verified: 2026-11-06: no official docs page found; endpoint taken from third-party guides and confirmed live (401 with an OAuth challenge).

gmail.use_for: Reading, searching, labelling and drafting in Tom's Gmail. The first choice for /inbox.
gmail.not_for: Other mailboxes; use composio (Outlook) or pasted text
gmail.fallback: composio Gmail, or pasted email text
gmail.auth: Connected on claude.ai. In a session this is the claude.ai Gmail connector: search_threads, get_thread, list_drafts, create_draft and the rest, behind a connector-ID prefix (mcp__<id>__). It also has send_message, reply, forward and trash tools, which need Tom's yes. The small-business plugin loads a second Gmail server (mcp__plugin_small-business_gmail__*) with no send tool; it is not this entry.
gmail.approval: Drafting is fine. Sending, archiving, labelling or deleting needs Tom's explicit OK.
gmail.verified: 2026-11-06: used for the first live /inbox run (search, read threads, labels, drafts).

canva.use_for: Designs with layout and text: social graphics, carousels, posters, one-pagers, decks, brand templates.
canva.not_for: Photoreal images or video generation; use higgsfield
canva.approval: Publishing or sharing a design needs Tom's OK.
canva.verified: 2026-11-06: Canva connector tools present in sessions.

browser.use_for: The Claude app's built-in browser: open pages, click, fill, read console and network. Needs no install, so it backs up playwright and chrome-devtools.
browser.not_for: Large scraping jobs; use apify or firecrawl
browser.auth: Tom's sign-ins in the pane belong to him; never sign out or change them.
browser.approval: Same rules as any browser: no purchases, posts or form submissions without Tom's OK.
